issues.message: dz_profile is not uniform within the 4 interior cells adjacent to the z_hi absorber face (max adjacent cell-ratio deviation 0.0909). WHY: the absorber pad replicates the outermost interior cell, so a transition in that runway changes the discrete medium in the boundary-NORMAL direction exactly where the absorber starts — the documented PML breakdown class — and gives the transition's own reflection no runway to separate from the absorber's. COST: the validated multi-band envelope does not cover it at all; no witness in it MEASURES an accuracy observable with an absorber present (every accuracy witness is PEC-closed at cpml_layers = 0; the one absorber-bearing witness checks the AD path only) (docs/guides/support_matrix.md, 'Multi-band graded mesh'). REMEDY: keep at least 4 uniform interior cells against that face, or close it with PEC/PMC. STALE-IF: a witness that SCORES an accuracy observable with an absorber present is added to that row.

issues.message: face x_lo is declared cpml with 4 layers. face x_hi is declared cpml with 4 layers. face y_lo is declared cpml with 4 layers. face y_hi is declared cpml with 4 layers. face z_lo is declared cpml with 4 layers. face z_hi is declared cpml with 4 layers. CPML reference reflections measured at 1 mm cells with the shipped CFS alpha (#1272, #1346): 4 layers: -20 dB at 2 GHz, -23 dB at 10 GHz, -17 dB at 30 GHz, -6 dB below 1 GHz. These reference values do not predict reflection on a different mesh or for UPML. Use at least 8 absorbing layers; 16 layers is the default recommendation.
